heroHeadline: Houthi Attacks Testing Mecca Pact Limits as Chiefs of Staff Hold First Talks in Riyadh
heroSubtitle: South China Morning Post analysis finds ongoing Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia are straining the Mecca regional security pact's obligations, as member states face pressure to move beyond technical assistance. Turkey's and Pakistan's top generals met Saudi counterparts on Sep 25 for the pact's first chiefs-of-staff talks since the Houthi barrage began, while France announced a bilateral deployment of troops, radar and air-defense systems to protect Yanbu — the first concrete foreign reinforcement, outside the pact's own machinery.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
